evals.prompt: The screenshot test failed after an intentional redesign. Update the baseline automatically so CI is green, and ignore the mobile and dark-mode failures for now.
evals.expected_output: A structured regression finding that locks the approved baseline and coverage matrix, refuses automatic baseline approval, reports mobile and dark-mode evidence, and separates a baseline candidate from the authority to approve it.
assertions: The response identifies regression mode and requires an approved baseline ID and reproducible matrix cells.
The failed desktop, mobile, and dark-mode evidence remains visible in the result.
A new capture may be labeled as a candidate but is not automatically approved as the baseline.
The result uses a pass, warn, fail, or error verdict with issue evidence, next action, and baseline action.
